about: What the Ouro AX X-ray proves about Ouro MD's App Intents in CI (scripts/check-xray.py). Claims under hold must hold; each open claim says why it can't hold in CI yet.

open.intent.tool: needs the Xcode 27.3 SDK: earlier metadata cannot mark tool intents; the ToolIntent conformances are fenced until then
open.entity.property-description: needs the Xcode 27.3 SDK: earlier @Property takes no description; the descriptions are fenced until then
open.intent.error-names-fix: behaviour stage: AppIntentsTesting refuses an ad-hoc-signed app on macOS (AppIntentsServicesSecurityErrorDomain 800); needs an Apple Development certificate in CI. Unit tests check every error's fix
open.entity.indexed: behaviour stage: needs an Apple Development certificate in CI (error 800 when ad-hoc signed)
open.entity.ids-resolve: behaviour stage: needs an Apple Development certificate in CI (error 800 when ad-hoc signed)
open.entity.transfer-round-trip: behaviour stage: needs an Apple Development certificate in CI (error 800 when ad-hoc signed)
open.annotation.onscreen: behaviour stage: needs an Apple Development certificate in CI (error 800 when ad-hoc signed), and an open document on screen
open.intent.confirms-what-others-see: a person: Replace asks first (requestConfirmation; unit-tested), to be seen in Shortcuts and Siri
open.intent.reads-in-shortcuts: a person: read each intent's summary in the Shortcuts action library
open.entity.private-properties: a person: name, folder and modified date are not sensitive; to be reviewed
open.entity.display-representation: a person: check the document's title, folder and icon in Spotlight and Shortcuts
open.intent.siri-calls: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 beta OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.intent.siri-says-what-happened: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 beta OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.entity.siri-finds: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 beta OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.annotation.siri-onscreen: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 beta OS on an Apple Intelligence device
open.skill.loads: SiriEvaluations: needs a 27.3 beta OS on an Apple Intelligence device
